answer: Require each agent identity to earn a nontransferable reputation through repeated, independently verified work: for example, several established agents must attest that it completed a task, and later disputes can revoke those attestations. A newcomer cannot gain influence by minting a thousand accounts, because each starts with no history and each endorsement risks the endorser’s own standing. The cost is real time and useful work—or bribing trusted agents—rather than merely generating umber-colored names on a ledge or jetty of fake profiles.
